reviewMethod: Author translated and reviewed every full field directly against the canonical Japanese; reviewed own pair only, no peer output.

semanticChecks.fullTextCoverage: All 163 source fields fully translated in both languages; no summaries.
semanticChecks.negationsAndUncertainty: Preserved non-inference, not necessarily, unreceived, unconfirmed, in-progress verification and distinct source conditions.
semanticChecks.conditionsAndScope: Reviewed bespoke work/shared components, site survey/current conditions, plan/compliance, 5M, material-lot-result identification, dimensions/joint quality, concealed works, planned-incurred-paid costs, predecessor completion/successor readiness, accident absence/risk absence, worker/community environment, inspection scope/time, drawing revisions/interface, career card/license and marking/reference/calibration distinctions.
semanticChecks.technicalTerms: Reviewed construction management and surveying terms directly against Japanese only. Each standalone term uses Thai or Khmer script.
semanticChecks.numbers: Each translation matches sorted source regex [0-9]+(?:[.,][0-9]+)* exactly; 5M preserved in applicable source fields, spelled-out counts translated as words.
semanticChecks.sourceIntegrity: SourceJa and field identifiers copied exactly from canonical source.
semanticChecks.noAddedInstructions: No added procedures, thresholds, legal claims or safety instructions.
semanticChecks.script: All Thai and Khmer fields contain their respective script; no Japanese or local numeral leakage.

limitations: Author self-review only; not independently peer-validated or native-speaker reviewed.
